newsitem.title: USA: American Real Estate sees no '97 payouts.
newsitem.headline: American Real Estate sees no '97 payouts.

text.p: American Real Estate Partners LP said on Wednesday that no distributions are expected to be made in 1997.
American Real Estate said it plans to apply operating cash flow toward operations, repayment of maturing debt, tenant improvements and other capita spending and for the creation of cash reserves.

The cash reserves are to cover environmental matters and scheduled lease expirations, the company said. At the end of the year 2000, about 23 percent of the company' net annual rentals from its portfolio will be up for renewal, it said.
